newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent pressured lower by APIs and profit-takin.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent pressured lower by APIs and profit-takin.

text.p: IPE Brent futures fell on Wednesday morning as bearish U.S. oil stock data and profit-taking ate further into Monday's 79 cents gain, traders said.
June IPE Brent was trading 35 cents lower at $19.27 a barrel at 1200 GMT, while gas oil was $3.0 off at $170.25 a tonne.
Bearish American Petroleum Institute (API) oil stock statistics released late on Tuesday were cited as the main cause of the fall.
U.S. crude stocks rose 6.94 million barrels to 322.63 million barrels in the week ending May 9, leaving stocks some 23 million barrels against year-ago levels.
Some U.S. traders, however, have expressed consternation at the size of the build, questioning the credibility of the data.
Gasoline stocks grew 6.51 million barrels to 197.06 million. "The APIs were the main factor," said one trader. "But there was also a feeling in the market that Brent had got ahead of itself."
While fundamentals implied a bearish outlook, many players remained upbeat when it came to technicals.
